text:
Maya (CS): quick sync on Orion Systems private/VPC onboarding — they finished network peering but have a few asks around KMS, cross-account IAM, and forwarding audit logs to their splunk collector. go-live target = 3/22 (renewal mood: sensitive). can we confirm next steps?
Dan (Solutions Eng): thanks Maya. can you paste their required CIDR + desired KMS setup? also flagging they want per-env CMKs (prod/stage) and import lifecycle docs.
Maya (CS): CIDR = 10.40.0.0/16 for redwood peering. They want: separate KMS keys, CloudTrail -> S3 -> Splunk HEC, and a cross-account role with external-id. they asked if we can host the bucket or they will.
Rachel (NetOps): we prefer customer-managed S3 for audit retention, but we can host for short-term. If customer hosts, we need bucket policy with our write principal and encryption using their CMK. Example policy snippet they need: 
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Sid": "AllowRedwoodPut",
    "Effect": "Allow",
    "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-audit-writer"},
    "Action": "s3:PutObject",
    "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::orion-redwood-audit/*"
  }]
}
```
Maya (CS): Dan, Rachel — Orion asked about KMS key policy because their security team requires a separate key per env and key rotation within 90 days. they also require key access limited to the cross-account role and the cloudtrail principal.
Tom (Security): ok for per-env CMKs. we need the KMS key ARN format in their policy. minimal example we give them: 
`arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:987654321098:key/aaaaaaaa-bbbb-cccc-dddd-eeeeeeeeeeee`
and external-role ARN for assume role: 
`arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/RedwoodCrossAccountWriteRole`
Tom (Security): also ask them to include an external-id we provide (rotating) in the trust policy. prevents confused deputy.
Maya (CS): Orion also wants audit logs forwarded to Splunk. their HEC endpoint is something like `https://splunk.orion-corp.com:8088/services/collector` and they want logs zipped + gzipped every 10m. is that supported?
Dan (Solutions Eng): yes — we can set up a CloudTrail + Lambda -> Kinesis Firehose -> Splunk HEC flow. note: if using customer CMK, Firehose needs kms:Decrypt permission on that key. We'll draft the IAM role required.
Rachel (NetOps): practical note: their firewall team blocks outbound to 8088 except from our NAT IPs. can we provide a list of egress IPs for the connector?
Maya (CS): they asked about egress IP list for the Splunk delivery. their security lead will only sign off if IPs are static.
Dan (Solutions Eng): infra-bot created a task: SUPPORT-2148 — we will allocate a stable egress NAT via our VPC egress pool for Orion (estimate 1 static IP).
infra-bot: created ticket SUPPORT-2148 and assigned to eng-infra; ETA 3 business days for NAT allocation.
Tom (Security): action items for Orion and Redwood:
- Orion: provide bucket name (if self-hosting), CMK ARNs for prod/stage, and firewall rule to allow our NAT IP.
- Redwood: provide cross-account role ARN + external-id, sample bucket policy + key policy, and run a failover test for Splunk ingestion.
Maya (CS): scheduling enablement session — they requested a 45m runbook walk-through next week (Wed 10am PT). can Dan or Rachel join? this is also a renewal checkpoint; if we miss go-live we risk push on contract renewal.
Dan (Solutions Eng): I can join Wed 10am PT. will prepare runbook and a short demo of the CloudTrail->Firehose path.
Rachel (NetOps): I can do the network bit, but only for the first 30m (have another call at 10:30).
Maya (CS): perfect. I'll send a calendar invite with agenda: 1) KMS/key policies (10m) 2) S3 bucket + CloudTrail (10m) 3) Splunk delivery & firewall (15m) 4) cutover plan & rollback (10m).
Tom (Security): one more ask: please ensure we capture key rotation proof for renewal box. they want documented rotation cadence + last rotated timestamp.
Maya (CS): noted — adding to the enablement checklist.
Orion (customer): @Maya thanks — we'll provide CMK ARNs and S3 bucket by EOD tomorrow. can you confirm the external-id format?
Maya (CS): external-id will be a short UUID we generate per customer, e.g., `5f2b1a4e-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-9a1b2c3d4e5f`. I'll post the real one in the invite once infra-bot returns the NAT IP. :thumbsup:
Dan (Solutions Eng): I'll draft the role/trust policy and paste before EOD.
infra-bot: update SUPPORT-2148: NAT IP provisioned 34.218.77.12 (allocated to orion-vpc-egress).
Rachel (NetOps): 34.218.77.12 noted — Orion please ask your firewall team to allow outbound to splunk.orion-corp.com:8088 from that IP.
Maya (CS): thanks team — logging actions in Playbook. renewal risk = medium if we hit the 3/22 go-live; I'll escalate to AM if any delay. will follow up after the enablement session. :spiral_calendar:
